headline: Is Cboe Global Markets (CBOE) Stock Already Priced For Perfection?
summary: Cboe Global Markets stock has delivered a strong 174.0% return over the last 5 years, yet the current valuation checks lean expensive rather than cheap. After this run, the stock’s recent price of US$310.23 sits against a low overall value score and an overvalued reading on traditional market multiples.
